primary.title: The Epistles of Paul
primary.author: Paul the Apostle
primary.rationale: A collection of letters attributed to Paul, forming a significant portion of the New Testament. These are foundational texts for understanding his theology and ministry.

primary.title: Epistle to the Romans
primary.author: Paul the Apostle
primary.rationale: Considered one of Paul's most important epistles, offering a systematic exposition of his theological views.

primary.title: First Epistle to the Corinthians
primary.author: Paul the Apostle
primary.rationale: This epistle addresses various issues within the Corinthian church, providing insights into early Christian community life and Paul's pastoral concerns.

secondary.title: Paul: A Very Short Introduction
secondary.author: E. P. Sanders
secondary.rationale: A concise and accessible overview of Paul's life, letters, and theology by a leading scholar in the field.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to St. Paul
secondary.author: Harold W. Attridge
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive collection of essays by various scholars covering different aspects of Paul's life, thought, and influence.

secondary.title: Paul the Apostle: His Life and Theology
secondary.author: Stephen J. Patterson
secondary.rationale: A scholarly examination of Paul's historical context, his missionary activities, and the development of his theological ideas.

suggestions.notes: The dates for the epistles are approximate and based on scholarly consensus. The 'Epistles of Paul' is a general category encompassing multiple individual letters.
